summary: ACPAssessmentFR is the French version of the Canadian Physiotherapy Assessment of Clinical Performance (ACP) used for evaluating physiotherapy students during clinical placement. The tool is based on the national Entry-to-Practice physiotherapy competency profile, with assessment items mapped to essential competencies. It is structured as a web-based multi-step wizard with defined roles and sections, using radio buttons, checkboxes, text fields, and validation logic. The assessment captures midterm and final evaluations, comments, and recommendations, supporting both individual and joint submissions.
purpose: To objectively assess physiotherapy students' clinical performance according to nationally accepted competencies during their clinical placements, supporting decision-making for progression and certification.
fields: Other various UI controls representing questions and metadata per section

workflows.name: Assessment Wizard Workflow
steps: User (assessor) logs in and opens the assessment.
Assessment details are loaded (student name, site, dates, type).

Wizard navigates through sections: Instructions, Definitions, Expert Assessment (1.x), Communicator (2.x), Collaborator (3.x), Manager (4.x), Advocate (5.x), Scholarly Practitioner (6.x), Professional (7.x), Summative Comments, Submit, Complete.
For each section, relevant questions are rendered as radio button groups with Likert scales for both midterm and final evaluations.
Text fields are provided for narrative feedback ('comments'), and checkboxes allow flagging of areas of concern.
Dropdown used at submission for global recommendations (pass, fail, pass with honors, etc.).
Validation ensures required responses are completed before proceeding or submission.
Assessment is saved at each step; navigation is allowed via buttons.
At submission, if all required questions are answered, the assessor can finalize and submit either as individual or joint evaluation.
Assessment status updates and submission notifications are handled by the system.

business_rules: Assessment cannot be submitted unless all required fields are completed.
Certain questions require exactly 10 options (Likert scale 1-10); this is validated.
Midterm and final evaluations are separated using AssessmentTypeCode logic.
A 'readonly' flag disables controls for read-only mode.
If multiple assessors exist, an option for joint assessment is shown.
Dropdown recommendations are required before final submission.
For '4.2 Administer and supervise staff,' if not applicable, reason must be provided in comments.
validations: Text fields have a max length (e.g., 2000 characters).
Number input validation for days absent and extra hours worked.
Backend validation for proper number of options per question.
Front-end disables controls based on readonly or assessment stage.
calculations: Days absent and extra hours worked are parsed and validated as decimals.
Overall performance is inferred from responses and recommendations.
Wizard step completion flags are calculated and used for navigation.
conditions: If interim, only midterm controls are enabled.
If final, both midterm and final controls are shown; only final is enabled.
